outputs: Predicted entities for the missing position in the quadruple
The output is a predicted entity for a query quadruple (e.g., (?, p, o, t) or (s, p, ?, t)) in temporal knowledge graph forecasting, generated via in-context learning with LLMs.

changes_made.explanation: This paper is about temporal knowledge graph forecasting, not natural language generation. The outputs are structured entities/relations (predicting missing components in quadruples), not generated natural language text. Therefore, this is not an NLG paper and all NLG-related metadata has been removed.

Since this is not an NLG paper (answer 1 is No), the Hits@K metrics are used for link prediction evaluation in knowledge graphs, not for evaluating generated natural language text. Therefore, these are not NLG evaluation metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate generated outputs. LLMs are used for the forecasting task itself (generation), but not for evaluation.
No human evaluations are conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely automated using Hits@K metrics on link prediction tasks.

overall_notes: This paper is about temporal knowledge graph forecasting using in-context learning with LLMs. While it uses language models, the task is structured prediction (link prediction in knowledge graphs) rather than natural language generation. Therefore, it does not fall under the scope of NLG evaluation papers. The Hits@K metrics are standard for knowledge graph completion tasks, not for evaluating generated text quality.
